summary: CI only: publication verification requires the exact native output in the owned binary cache and every dependency in either that cache or cache.nixos.org. This matches Cachix's omission of upstream-available paths while still failing if any closure member is unavailable remotely.

replay.detail: No record or storage format changes.

schema.detail: No schema change; publication retains its closure manifest and receipt.

rules.detail: CI-only remote availability proof; no runtime or admission rules change.

compatibility.detail: Package identity and consumer cache configuration are unchanged.

manual.detail: No upgrade action required; failed publication runs can be backfilled after merge.
